rebuildErrors.identityConflict: Rebuilding stopped because a canonical note ID is duplicated or conflicts with a stale indexed path. Check the paths below. rebuildErrors.invalidMetadata: Rebuilding stopped because metadata in the listed files is invalid or unsupported. Fix the indicated metadata, then explicitly rebuild. No files were rewritten and the previous index was kept.

rebuildErrors.changedExternally: Rebuilding stopped because file continuity could not be verified. Check the paths below and reconcile external changes before explicitly rebuilding. The previous index was kept.

library.title: Meeting library
library.intro: Record microphone and output monitor as separate local originals. No note is required.
library.desktopRequired: The desktop runtime is required to enumerate sources, record and play local recordings. Browser preview does not record audio.
library.noMonitor: No output monitor is available. Check desktop audio support and refresh the library.
library.playbackNotice: Separate raw tracks. Pauses are excluded. These players do not establish synchronized wall-clock playback.
library.playbackError: Could not play this local audio track.
library.pipelinePending: Transcription, diarization and speaker identity are pending. A microphone source does not identify a person.
library.selectRecording: Select a recording to inspect its tracks.
library.emptyTrack: At least one track contains no audio frames. Recovery does not turn an empty capture into a successful recording.

processing.title: Local processing
processing.notice: Choose an explicit local model configuration. Models are never downloaded. Processing and capture cannot run together.
processing.configPlaceholder: Select the supplied local-models.json configuration file.
processing.running: Local processing in progress. The library remains available.
processing.unknown: Voice recognition remains unknown without compatible calibration. Anonymous clusters are experimental. Reprocessing requires new identity confirmation.
processing.experimentalWarning: Experimental speaker grouping. Similarity thresholds are parameters, not calibrated confidence. Overlapping and ambiguous speech remain unattributed.
processing.participantNotice: Private local context entered by you. No Outlook connection or verified attendance. Selecting a name only prefills creation; it does not identify or learn a voice.
processing.enrollOptIn: Also enroll eligible voice excerpts in the private voice profile
processing.enrollNotice: Optional and off by default. Confirming a name alone does not enroll voice samples. Listen to the excerpts before choosing.
processing.voiceSuggestion: Suggested by voice, awaiting your confirmation
processing.calibrated: Voice suggestions use a validated compatible policy. Suggestions are not confirmations.
processing.uncalibrated: No compatible validated calibration policy is available. Voice identity remains unknown.

reasons.uncalibrated embedding space: No validated policy for this voice model.
reasons.below calibrated threshold: Voice evidence is below the validated policy threshold.
reasons.missing_policy: No validated calibration policy is installed.
reasons.ambiguous turn-level acoustic evidence: Acoustic evidence across voice excerpts is ambiguous.

processing.legacyAssignments: Previous identities without a defined track
processing.legacyNotice: These historical decisions are not assigned to the current voice groups. Their samples may still contribute to voice profiles until revoked.
processing.overlapWarning: Text attribution overlap-v2 uses at least 70% same-track union coverage and abstains on competing or unknown speech. This is an algorithm parameter, not calibrated confidence.

library.devicesFailed: Could not refresh audio devices. Check the audio service and try again.

noteError.title: Note unavailable
noteError.description: This note could not be opened. You can return to your library or try again.

desktopRecovery.title: Coxinha needs attention
desktopRecovery.description: This screen failed. Retry or open another section. Existing files remain available. Local diagnostics:
desktopRecovery.startup: Notes or desktop shortcuts could not load. Retry to reconnect.
desktopRecovery.saveFailed: Changes could not be saved. Keep Coxinha open and retry.
desktopRecovery.delayed: Saving has not finished yet. Continue waiting or keep Coxinha open. A delay does not mean that saving failed.
desktopRecovery.attachmentPending: An attachment is still being inserted. Wait and retry, or keep Coxinha open to finish the note.
desktopRecovery.shutdownFailed: Recording finalization or shutdown failed. Keep Coxinha open to inspect the recording and recover, or retry.
desktopRecovery.discardWarning: Discarding abandons changes that have not reached disk. In-flight native writes finish first. Raw recordings are preserved, but finalization may be incomplete and require recovery next time. This does not confirm a successfully saved recording.

desktopRecording.label: Meeting status
desktopRecording.backgroundProcessing: You can navigate elsewhere while Coxinha processes this meeting.
desktopRecording.failed: Status or finalization needs attention. Open the library to inspect and recover.

outlook.tenant: Tenant ID or organizations, common, consumers
outlook.permissions: Read-only: Calendars.ReadBasic, openid and offline_access. Tokens stay in the OS credential store.
outlook.freshness: Local cache updated {{date}}. Data may be stale until the next synchronization.
outlook.empty: No cached appointments. Connect and synchronize to load the next 30 days.
outlook.candidateHint: Invitees are voice review candidates. An invitation does not confirm attendance or identity.
outlook.loadError: Could not read the local calendar. Reopen Agenda to retry.
outlook.meetingsError: Could not load the meeting library.
outlook.noAutoRecord: Calendar events do not start recording. Future automatic recording requires explicit opt-in.
outlook.title: Outlook calendar
outlook.description: Read-only sync of the next 30 days. Invitees become voice review candidates.
outlook.clientIdMissing: Fill in the Application (client) ID under advanced connection settings to connect.

calendar.accountChanged: The connected account changed. Disconnect and connect again.
calendar.cacheRead: Could not read the local calendar.
calendar.failed: Could not complete the operation. Check the network and retry.
calendar.reconnect: Reconnect Outlook. Credentials are missing or the OS store is unavailable.
calendar.storeDelete: Could not remove credentials from the OS store.
calendar.storeWrite: Could not save to the OS credential store.
calendar.secretTooLong: The credential exceeds the Windows secure-store limit (2,560 bytes including configuration). The connection was not saved. No plaintext fallback is used.
calendar.authorizationDenied: The provider rejected authorization. Check the application configuration and permissions.
calendar.candidateLimit: A meeting supports up to 100 candidates. Review existing candidates and choose a smaller list before adding invitees.

noteRecovery.openRebuildSettings: Open Settings at Rebuild note index
noteRecovery.invalidMetadata: The note metadata is invalid or unsupported. This operation was stopped. Copy any unsaved text, fix the marked metadata in the Markdown file, then explicitly rebuild the index in Settings. Retrying alone will not fix the metadata. No file was rewritten.
noteRecovery.changedExternally: The file at this note's path changed outside Coxinha, or its indexed body cannot be verified. This operation was stopped to preserve the file. Keep any unsaved text, reconcile the files outside Coxinha and explicitly rebuild the index if needed. Retrying alone will not resolve this conflict.
noteRecovery.identityConflict: The file at this note's path belongs to a different note. This operation was stopped. Keep any unsaved text, reconcile the files outside Coxinha and explicitly rebuild the index after resolving the move or conflict. Retrying alone will not resolve it.
noteRecovery.retainedConflict: Your pending Markdown remains available below. Keep this copy until the files are reconciled.
noteRecovery.missingOrMoved: The note file is missing from its original path. It may have been moved or deleted. Keep any unsaved text, restore the file or explicitly rebuild the index after a move, then retry. No file was recreated and the indexed identity was preserved.
noteRecovery.title: Recover unsaved note
noteRecovery.retained: Saving failed. The current Markdown remains available below. Copy it or retry saving.
noteRecovery.unavailable: Saving or conversion failed. No recoverable serialized snapshot is available. Keep the app open and retry; older saved text has not been opened over your edits.
noteRecovery.manualCopy: Clipboard unavailable. The text is selected; use your system copy command.

speakers.intro: Listen, choose a person and save each voice separately. Suggestions need your confirmation.
speakers.noCleanExcerpt: No isolated excerpt is available for this speaker.
speakers.decisionOrigin: How did you verify this identity?
speakers.decisionHelp: Required for saving or revoking. Describe the human evidence, for example: I know this person and reviewed this recording.
speakers.remember: Remember this voice for future meetings
speakers.enrollmentScope: Optional, off by default. This tries to save all available voice segments for this speaker on this track to the private profile, not only the excerpt played here. Enrollment may fail if any segment is unsuitable, including overlapping speech. Only opt in when the consent you recorded covers voice reuse. Individual sample selection is not available here.
speakers.consentHelp: Required to create a person. Record how consent was obtained and what it allows. An agenda name alone is not consent or proof of attendance.
speakers.legacyOrigin: Reason for revoking a previous identity
speakers.recognitionUnavailable: Voice suggestions are unavailable. You can still review identities manually.
speakers.noCalibration: Automatic voice recognition is still being evaluated. Confirm people manually.
speakers.calibrationReported: Proposed names still need your manual confirmation.
speakers.overlap: Unknown or overlapping speech remains unassigned and cannot be claimed here.
speakers.noSpeakers: No identifiable speaker turns in this version. Review or rerun transcription.
speakers.noRecording: No recording yet. Use recording controls or open the recording utility to import audio.
speakers.unavailable: Processed voices could not be loaded. Retry or open Transcript.
speakers.pending: Transcription is pending or running. Open Transcript to follow processing.
speakers.failed: Transcription failed. Open Transcript to review the error and retry.
speakers.empty: No processed voices yet. Open Transcript to configure and run transcription.
speakers.noCalibrationDetails: Automatic recognition depends on a compatible evaluated policy. Anonymous grouping is experimental, and reprocessing requires a new human confirmation.
speakers.decisionHelpShort: Required: describe how you verified this person in the recording.
speakers.alreadyConfirmed: This person is already confirmed. Choose a different person to correct the identity.

voiceCuration.identityOnly: Only explicitly selected samples train voice memory after confirmation.
voiceCuration.structuralNotice: Only checked samples train the private profile. Eligibility checks source and assignment structure, not acoustic purity. Listen and review each segment before selecting it. Nothing is selected automatically.
voiceCuration.unmeasured: Noise, echo and voices leaking from another track have not been measured.
voiceCuration.staleAssignment: This list does not match the current confirmed identity. Refresh before choosing samples.
voiceCuration.noTurns: No voice segments are available for this speaker.
voiceCuration.enrollmentOrigin: Consent and review for these selected samples
voiceCuration.enrollmentHelp: Describe the consent for future voice reuse and your review of these samples. Required, brief, without line breaks. Only the checked samples are enrolled; a failed batch enrolls none.
voiceCuration.privateNotice: Local private profiles, grouped by compatible voice model. Revoking a sample preserves its history. Identity confirmation and memory are separate.
voiceCuration.noSamples: No samples recorded for this person.
voiceCuration.revokeHelp: Required human decision. Revocation removes this sample from future voice comparisons while retaining its private history. Use a brief single-line explanation.
voiceCuration.comparisonNotice: Manual evidence only. Names and cosine scores do not confirm an identity or express confidence. This view never selects or applies a person. The same person may appear for several anonymous speakers. Current meeting and duplicate-source audio are excluded.
voiceCuration.noComparison: No comparable speaker evidence in this version.
voiceCuration.noEligibleQuery: No structurally eligible query segments for this speaker.
voiceCuration.truncated: Only the first 32 turn details are shown. Scores and support use all evaluated turns.

comparisonStates.no_compatible_history: No compatible active history for this voice model.
comparisonStates.self_excluded: All compatible history was excluded because it belongs to this meeting or duplicate source audio.
comparisonStates.no_candidates: Compatible history contains no usable nonself comparison evidence.

voiceCuration.previewNotice: Playback previews up to 12 seconds. Selecting a sample keeps its full listed interval.
voiceCuration.invalidOrigin: Use a shorter single-line explanation without control characters.
voiceCuration.confirmScope: The name applies to every turn of this group on this track. If voices are mixed or uncertain, leave it anonymous.
voiceCuration.staleView: This loaded view is stale. Restart the list before continuing or changing samples.
voiceCuration.loadedSpaceComplete: Loaded active samples: {{count}} · loaded duration {{duration}} (end of snapshot)
voiceCuration.noLoadedActiveSpace: No active samples among the loaded rows.

errors.voice_curation_capacity_exceeded: This operation exceeds the active voice-evidence capacity. You can still browse pages and revoke individual samples; no partial result was applied.
errors.voice_curation_refresh_required: Voice memory changed. Restart this list or refresh the comparison before continuing.
errors.voice_curation_busy: Another voice comparison is running. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
errors.voice_curation_inventory_row_invalid: An unreadable record blocks this sample page. Other people and already loaded rows remain available. Report the error; the record was not skipped.
errors.voice_curation_cursor_invalid: This page cursor is invalid for the current list. Restart the list from its beginning.

peopleDirectory.title: People & voices
peopleDirectory.description: One local registry for all meetings. Maintain people and the voice samples you have confirmed.
peopleDirectory.training: To teach a voice, open a meeting, identify its speaker and select the samples to remember. Creating a person alone does not train recognition.
peopleDirectory.meetingContext: Identify the speakers in this meeting. People and confirmed voice samples belong to the global People & voices registry.
peopleDirectory.noMatch: No match among the loaded people. Load more people to continue searching.

form.nameHint: As it should appear in meetings and notes.
form.needName: Enter the person's name to create them.
form.needConsent: Describe the source and scope of consent to create this person.
